findings.title: Session kept in localStorage: initPro runs in legacy-bearer mode on a hosted app

applicability.reason: Hosted at tasks-demo.proappstore.online (deploy.yml uploads to apps/tasks-demo/)

evidence.observation: No authMode option — the SDK default is legacy-bearer, so the session token is cached under localStorage['pas:session']

findings.impact: Any script on the app origin can read the platform session token and drive every SDK call as the user; the secret proxy is unavailable in this mode.
findings.remediation: Pass authMode: 'platform-cookie' in web/src/lib/app.ts and remove code that reads the session; verify sign-in, one data call and sign-out on the live app.
acceptance_tests: document.cookie on the live app does not contain a session

findings.title: App reads the platform session from localStorage in web/src/lib/session.ts

applicability.reason: Hosted at tasks-demo.proappstore.online (deploy.yml uploads to apps/tasks-demo/)

evidence.observation: The app reads the SDK's pas:session key itself; session persistence belongs to the SDK and the host worker only

findings.impact: The session token is exposed to every script on the page and outlives sign-out.
findings.remediation: Delete web/src/lib/session.ts and its call sites; rely on authMode: 'platform-cookie' and app.auth.init().
acceptance_tests: after sign-out no storage key and no cookie carries identity
